name: Activity Monitor Pro
author: Wole Akinloye

sections.description:
Activity Monitor Pro is a powerful tool designed to help you keep track of everything happening on your WordPress site. From user logins to content updates, this plugin provides a detailed log of activities, ensuring you have full visibility and control.

Key Features:

  • Comprehensive Activity Log: Track user actions, system updates, and more.
  • Undo/Redo Functionality: Easily reverse changes made to posts, pages, and settings.
  • AI-Powered Anomaly Detection: Detect suspicious behavior and potential security threats (Premium).
  • Detailed Reporting: Generate reports to analyze site activity over time.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/activity-monitor-pro directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘Activity Monitor’ menu to view logs and configure settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin slow down my site?

No, Activity Monitor Pro is optimized for performance and uses efficient database queries to minimize impact on your site’s speed.

Can I undo any action?

The plugin supports undoing many common actions like post updates, trash, and setting changes. Some actions may not be reversible.
